page.overview:
What is I Wanna Be Your Man?

I Wanna Be Your Man is a song by The Beatles. It is the fourth on side two of The Beatles' Second UK LP, "With The Beatles". It is credited to Lennon/McCartney. Although Paul primarily wrote it, John helped finish the song-writing. It is unknown whether it was specially written for Ringo, with him in mind. They gave the song to the Rolling Stones. The following day, they recorded it themselves with Ringo on lead.
